description: This PHP source file defines an API endpoint class `VacancyAttachmentAPI` for managing vacancy attachments in a recruitment module. It includes methods for creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving vacancy attachment data, with appropriate validation rules, request handling, and API documentation annotations.

classes.name: VacancyAttachmentAPI
classes.description: PHP class providing API endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting vacancy attachments in the recruitment module.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Stub method for retrieving all vacancy attachments, not implemented.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Stub method for validation rules for get all, not implemented.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new vacancy attachment, including setting attachment details and persisting it.

methods.name: setVacancyAttachment
methods.description: Sets vacancy ID, comment, and attachment type from request parameters into the VacancyAttachment entity.

methods.name: setBase64Attachment
methods.description: Sets file content, filename, and filetype into VacancyAttachment from base64 encoded attachment.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules needed for create operation.

methods.name: getAttachmentRule
methods.description: Defines validation rule for attachment data in creation.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Returns common validation rules for request bodies.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes vacancy attachments based on provided IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves attachments for a specific vacancy ID.

methods.name: getVacancyAttachments
methods.description: Internal method to fetch a collection of attachments and their count for a vacancy.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates a vacancy attachment, including optionally replacing its base64 content.

methods.name: getRecruitmentAttachment
